mainEntity.name: Is geo-specific topic clustering different from standard local SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Geo-specific topic clustering is a specialized strategy *within* local SEO, not a replacement for it. While standard local SEO covers foundational elements like Google Business Profile optimization, local citations, and localized landing pages, topic clustering focuses specifically on structuring your *content* for improved local search visibility. It enhances your authority for local queries by demonstrating comprehensive expertise across a network of interconnected local content, going beyond basic optimization.
acceptedAnswer.description: It's a content structuring strategy within local SEO, enhancing authority for local queries by demonstrating comprehensive expertise, complementing standard local SEO efforts.
